# 词典 D

## 概述

本页收录以字母 D 开头的实用词汇，按职场与商务、日常与社交、技术相关等场景分组。每个词条给出词性、含义、常见搭配与例句，并附易混淆词辨析和高频短语，便于按场景查阅与记忆。

## 职场与商务

| 词汇          | 词性  | 含义       | 常见搭配                       | 例句                                                            |
| ------------- | ----- | ---------- | ------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| deadline      | n.    | 截止日期   | meet/miss a deadline           | We must meet the deadline for the product launch.               |
| delegate      | v./n. | 委派/代表  | delegate tasks/authority       | Good leaders know when to delegate tasks effectively.           |
| deliver       | v.    | 交付、发表 | deliver results/a presentation | The team delivered the MVP on time.                             |
| deprecate     | v.    | 弃用       | deprecate a feature/API        | We plan to deprecate the v1 API next quarter.                   |
| discipline    | n.    | 纪律、学科 | self-discipline                | Building good coding habits requires discipline.                |
| diversity     | n.    | 多样性     | diversity and inclusion        | Our company values diversity in hiring practices.               |
| documentation | n.    | 文档       | write documentation            | Clear documentation saves onboarding time.                      |
| downsize      | v.    | 裁员、缩减 | downsize the team              | The startup was forced to downsize after funding dried up.      |
| due diligence | n.    | 尽职调查   | conduct due diligence          | Conduct due diligence before signing any partnership agreement. |
| disclose      | v.    | 披露       | disclose information           | Companies must disclose financial data to investors.            |
| demote        | v.    | 降职       | demote an employee             | He was demoted after the project failure.                       |
| dividend      | n.    | 红利       | pay dividends                  | The company pays dividends to shareholders quarterly.           |

## 日常与社交

| 词汇        | 词性 | 含义               | 常见搭配                    | 例句                                                     |
| ----------- | ---- | ------------------ | --------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| decent      | adj. | 像样的、体面的     | decent salary/meal          | The cafeteria serves decent food at reasonable prices.   |
| destination | n.   | 目的地             | travel destination          | Tokyo is a popular travel destination in Asia.           |
| dilemma     | n.   | 两难困境           | face a dilemma              | I'm facing a dilemma between two job offers.             |
| dine        | v.   | 用餐               | dine out/in                 | We dined out at a new Italian restaurant last night.     |
| distinguish | v.   | 区分               | distinguish between A and B | It's hard to distinguish between the two flavors.        |
| donate      | v.   | 捐赠               | donate money/blood          | She donates to charity every month.                      |
| downtime    | n.   | 休息时间、停机时间 | enjoy some downtime         | I like reading during my downtime on weekends.           |
| drastic     | adj. | 剧烈的、极端的     | drastic change/measures     | Moving abroad was a drastic but rewarding decision.      |
| durable     | adj. | 耐用的             | durable material            | This backpack is made of durable waterproof fabric.      |
| diligent    | adj. | 勤奋的             | diligent worker             | She is a diligent student who always submits work early. |

## 技术相关

| 词汇       | 词性  | 含义             | 常见搭配                      | 例句                                                    |
| ---------- | ----- | ---------------- | ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| database   | n.    | 数据库           | relational database           | The user data is stored in a PostgreSQL database.       |
| debug      | v.    | 调试             | debug code/an issue           | I spent two hours debugging this memory leak.           |
| deploy     | v.    | 部署             | deploy to production          | We deploy new features every two weeks.                 |
| dependency | n.    | 依赖             | install dependencies          | The build failed due to a missing dependency.           |
| dashboard  | n.    | 仪表盘、控制面板 | analytics dashboard           | The dashboard shows real-time user metrics.             |
| decryption | n.    | 解密             | data decryption               | Decryption of the payload requires a private key.       |
| DevOps     | n.    | 开发运维         | DevOps pipeline/engineer      | Our DevOps team manages the CI/CD infrastructure.       |
| domain     | n.    | 域、领域         | domain name, domain knowledge | You need domain knowledge to design this feature well.  |
| daemon     | n.    | 守护进程         | background daemon             | The logging daemon runs continuously in the background. |
| diff       | n./v. | 差异/比较差异    | code diff, diff two files     | Review the diff carefully before approving the PR.      |
| DNS        | n.    | 域名系统         | DNS resolution, DNS record    | DNS propagation can take up to 48 hours.                |

## 易混淆词辨析

| 词组                 | 区别说明                                                                                              |
| -------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| deny vs. refuse      | deny「否认事实」，refuse「拒绝请求」。He **denied** the accusation. / She **refused** the invitation. |
| discover vs. invent  | discover「发现已存在的」，invent「发明新事物」。**Discover** a bug. / **Invent** a solution.          |
| device vs. devise    | device 名词「设备」，devise 动词「设计、想出」。Mobile **device**. / **Devise** a plan.               |
| despite vs. although | despite 后接名词，although 后接从句。**Despite** the rain... / **Although** it rained...              |

## 高频短语

| 短语         | 含义       | 例句                                                         |
| ------------ | ---------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| due to       | 由于       | The release was postponed due to critical bugs.              |
| deal with    | 处理       | Let me deal with this issue before the meeting.              |
| drill down   | 深入分析   | We need to drill down into the root cause.                   |
| double-check | 仔细检查   | Please double-check the configuration before deploying.      |
| draw up      | 起草       | The legal team will draw up the contract this week.          |
| drop off     | 下降、送达 | User engagement tends to drop off after the first week.      |
| do away with | 废除、去掉 | We decided to do away with the legacy authentication system. |
| dial in      | 精确调整   | Let's dial in the performance thresholds for alerting.       |
| dawn on      | 意识到     | It dawned on me that the config file was missing.            |
| dig into     | 深入研究   | Let's dig into the logs to find the root cause.              |

## 补充词汇

| 词汇          | 词性      | 含义     | 常见搭配                |
| ------------- | --------- | -------- | ----------------------- |
| deprecated    | adj.      | 已弃用的 | deprecated method/API   |
| deterministic | adj.      | 确定性的 | deterministic output    |
| directive     | n.        | 指令     | compiler directive      |
| downstream    | adj./adv. | 下游的   | downstream service      |
| dynamic       | adj.      | 动态的   | dynamic content/routing |
| decouple      | v.        | 解耦     | decouple components     |
